title: split-lint-runner-into-typed-action-and-add-dependency-blacklist-gate
author: Sana Iqbal
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic ci.lint workflow has been a frequent source of flakiness, slow incremental runs, and opaque failures when dependency upgrades introduce lint rule regressions. This PR separates the lint runner into a strongly-typed TypeScript GitHub Action to improve error surface tracing, and introduces a lightweight dependency-blacklist gate that prevents known-bad dependency versions from progressing through the release pipeline.

What this PR does (summary):
- Extracts lint logic from .github/workflows/ci.yml into .github/actions/typed-lint-runner (TS action). The action validates config, runs eslint with project-aware caching, and emits structured annotations for failed rules.
- Introduces .github/workflows/dep-blacklist-gate.yml: a fast pre-merge check that scans package manifests and PR metadata against a curated blacklist in infra/dependency-blacklist.json. Blacklisted upgrades are blocked and a human-readable explanation is posted as a status check.
- Keeps CI matrix smaller by splitting lint and build: build matrix no longer runs eslint; lint is run in parallel as a dedicated job using the new action. This reduces redundant work on infra-heavy jobs and improves median CI runtime on small client PRs.
- Adds an opt-in --strict-lint flag for release branches that escalates certain rule failures to required checks for a short window after major releases.
- Adds unit tests for the typed action harness and a small integration smoke harness that runs eslint in Docker (to mirror the runner image).
- Adds migration notes for repo owners in docs/ci/typed-lint-migration.md and updates the internal CI runbook.

Files changed (high level):
- .github/actions/typed-lint-runner/action.yml (new)
- .github/actions/typed-lint-runner/src/index.ts (new)
- .github/actions/typed-lint-runner/package.json, tsconfig.json, tests/* (new)
- .github/workflows/dep-blacklist-gate.yml (new)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (modified: split lint jobs, reduced matrix)
- infra/dependency-blacklist.json (new)
- docs/ci/typed-lint-migration.md (new)
- scripts/ci/run-lint-legacy-compat.sh (modified for wrapper)

Commit summary (high-level):
- 7c3a1b2  extract typed lint action (ts) and tests
- a2d9f4e  add dep blacklist gate workflow and infra JSON
- b4e5a9c  split ci.yml: separate lint job, shrink build matrix
- d81f0aa  migration docs and runbook updates
- e13f7d0  follow-up: CI caching tweaks and flakiness retry for annotations

Testing / Validation performed:
- Local unit tests for action logic (node 18) and eslint rule parsing (jest).
- Spin up ephemeral runner in sandbox and executed smoke integration (full repo lint) — timings reduced from ~7m -> ~4m for client-only changes due to matrix reduction.
- Dep blacklist gate exercised with synthetic PRs: verified PR blocked and status check message produced.
- CI observed across a week in staging: two PRs that previously flaked due to racey coverage now fail deterministically with actionable annotations.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main behind a short maintenance window (low-traffic hours).
- Monitor CI queue depth and action invocation latency for 48h.
- If any downstream repo complains, add repo-specific opt-out in infra/dependency-blacklist.json and follow runbook.

Notes on backwards compatibility and migration:
- The new action fully supports the previous CLI args via wrapper script scripts/ci/run-lint-legacy-compat.sh. Repos can migrate to the typed action by updating their workflow to call uses: ./.github/actions/typed-lint-runner.
- The dep blacklist is conservative; infra team will maintain it. It can be extended to integrate with Dependabot PRs in a follow-up.

Related work / tracking: ENG-4281 (CI: Split lint runner), ENG-4399 (Depreg gate prototype), PM-1022 (Release stability improvements).

Checklist: 
- [x] Unit tests for action logic
- [x] Smoke integration verified on sandbox runner
- [x] Migration docs written
- [x] Infra/dependency blacklist added (initial curated entries)
- [x] CI passes in staging

Risks / Known limitations:
- The typed action increases JS/TS surface area in the repo (devDependencies). We pin install steps and perform integrity checks in the action to keep runtime deterministic.
- False-positives from the blacklist are possible; we included an override workflow for emergency unblocks.

If reviewers want to scope the change down, a follow-up can split the blacklist gate into a separate PR; the typed action can land independently too.

release_notes: Introduce a typed lint runner GitHub Action and an initial dependency blacklist gating workflow. Splits lint from build to reduce CI runtime and adds migration docs.
review_conversation: Martin Keller: Left a few nits on the action argument parsing — can we validate env var presence earlier?
Sana Iqbal: Good catch, added early validation and unit tests for missing envs (see e13f7d0)
Jaya Patel: Can the blacklist gate be surfaced as a label instead of a hard block for non-release PRs?

Sana Iqbal: We debated this; current impl is a hard block for any PR touching package.json/package-lock.json/package-bundle.yaml. We added an override token pattern for emergency unblocks and will revisit policy after initial rollout.
Diego Ramos: approved — action tests are solid and the migration docs cover downstream steps.
